records.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai!
records.meta: TV serial · India · Hindi · &TV (episode guide dates 6–7 Jan 2016)
records.mechanism: Learned stage hypnotism used on a spouse (comic)
records.summary: Vibhuti learns hypnotism from Saxena and uses it on Angoori (Manmohan's wife) to turn her against her husband; a hypnotised Angoori throws Manmohan out and beats him with a belt on command. Anita (Vibhuti's wife) later hypnotises Vibhuti himself in E225 (male victim, not counted).

episodes.gist: Vibhuti watches Saxena hypnotise Teeka Ram and Malkhan, learns the technique, then hypnotises Angoori after Manmohan boasts of controlling his wife

episodes.episode: E224 “A Hypnotised Angoori Beats Manmohan Black and Blue” (7 Jan 2016)
episodes.gist: A hypnotised Angoori kicks Manmohan out of the house; Vibhuti hypnotises her again and orders her to hit Manmohan, and she beats him with a belt; she cries on seeing him afterwards

records.note: Comedy. Angoori is an adult married woman; no pregnancy or children in these episodes. E225 (8 Jan 2016) has Anita hypnotise Vibhuti (male victim) and exposes the plan.

records.title: Pandya Store — E203 “Prafulla in Danger!”
records.meta: TV serial episode · India · Hindi · Star Plus (17 Sep 2021)
records.summary: Two women posing as vessel-exchange sellers praise Suman's eyes, hypnotise her into handing over her bangles and put her to sleep, then rob the house; Dhara (pregnant, asleep) wakes and is tied up, and Rishita arrives to find Suman asleep as the thieves escape.

episodes.gist: Thieves hypnotise Suman and rob the Pandya house

records.note: CONFLICT/loose fit: the Hotstar episode title names 'Prafulla', while the JustShowBiz written update names the hypnotised woman as Suman (the mother-in-law). Dhara is pregnant in this arc but is not the hypnotised person. Suman is an adult mother-in-law (grown family in the house).
records.kids_status: yes — adult family; mother-in-law of the household per recap
